text:
Hiro N: FYI opened PR 612 to add a small section on audit export UX + retention overrides. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 tagging legal + eng.
Meera S: thanks. goal is short & clear: example export flows, a tiny retention table, and one paragraph on PII handling that passes SOC2 review.
Evan P: i'll add Python + Go snippets (we've had requests). also want to note the encryption-at-rest line and KMS integration pointer.
Hiro N: yep include an explicit line: "Exported payloads are encrypted at rest and access is controlled via KMS keys bound to the tenant." link to KMS docs.
Sara L (Legal): suggested legal-safe phrasing: "By default, exports do not include tenant PII. Customers can enable pseudonymization via the pseudonymize flag; requests are recorded and require the auditor or admin role." fine to use?
Meera S: that's good. for inline docs i propose: "Exports omit tenant PII by default. Set pseudonymize=true to mask identifiers. Export requests require auditor or admin roles and are logged."
Evan P: added snippets: python requests example, go http client, and a note for SDKs: client.audit_logs.export(...). Also included migration note: mask_pii -> pseudonymize and /v1/export -> /v2/exports.
Hiro N: couple small asks: (1) call out that pseudonymize masks but does not strictly anonymize (for legal), (2) add a one-row example in the retention table showing tenant override:
- session_events: default 30 days, tenant override up to 365 days
- logs: default 365 days, tenant override up to 1095 days
- export_metadata: default 730 days, no tenant override
Meera S: re (1) wording: "Pseudonymization masks identifiers but does not guarantee irreversible anonymization; consult Legal for longer-term data strategies." ok?
Sara L (Legal): good. also add: "For SOC2 evidence, export operations and reviewer identities are retained in the audit trail."
docs-bot: PR 612 status: review requested by @Sara L (Legal), @Evan P. link-checker: one internal anchor flagged (kms-integration -> kms-keys) - suggested fix. docs-build: passed.
Evan P: i'll patch the anchor and add the Go snippet that prints job_id.
Hiro N: please also add the tiny migration note for telemetry: export_job_id -> job_id. customers with log forwards should be able to map.
Meera S: adding a brief note in the migration section and a small changelog bullet. aiming to merge this week after legal sign-off.
Sara L (Legal): left two inline punctuation nits, otherwise LGTM on the phrasing.
Hiro N: thanks all. once merged i'll follow up with a short tweet about the clarified export UX and link to docs.
docs-bot: PR 612 merged by @Hiro N - changelog updated.
